services.name: Duluth Charter Fishing
services.desc: Your Duluth Charter Fishing captain, Jordan, has 25+ years experience targeting anadromous trout and salmon on the world famous Brule River in Wisconsin as well as the turbid rivers of the Minnesota north shore. We can accommodate anglers of any skill level with top of the line spinning, centerpin, and fly rods available to our customers. WadersAny waders that are comfortable and dry will work. An important aspect to consider is your wading boots. The streambed of the Brule can be very slippery and boots with a felt bottom or studs are highly recommended. blurb: Guests fish Lake Superior for lake trout, chinook, coho salmon, brown trout, steelhead, and trophy walleye using tournament proven techniques. When Lake Superior is rough, trips target walleye and musky on the St. Louis River. Fly rod, centerpin, or drift rod trips are also offered on the Brule River and north shore streams in spring and fall.
